title: Queensland Brewery Company Building
scope: The surviving three-storey principal exterior at 501 Ann Street, known as Callaghan Place after conversion to educational use. Covers the rounded corner entry and tower, the Ann and Boundary Street wings, rear service elevations and roof mass.
limitations: The ground registration and plan follow original government elevations and the mapped building envelope. Floor, parapet and tower heights are estimates.
The contemporary description and public-domain photograph establish persistent heritage fabric. Current glass, secondary window details, exterior fittings and roof equipment are approximate.
The principal building is represented. The new school footbridge, other campus buildings and interiors are outside the model scope.
